title: Define deterministic isolated runner admission and enforcement
goal: Specify the first EVA-03 runner boundary without exposing unconfined execution
acceptance: Define threat model and fixed job admission using existing NERV grants, exact arguments, deadlines and least EVA class; do not add a second approval authority
Specify per-job filesystem mounts, network egress, credentials, process cancellation and CPU/memory/output limits for supported hosts
Keep grader and promotion authority outside candidate writes; preserve failed attempts and uncertain external effects in the ledger
Define escape, credential denial, grader tampering, timeout/cancellation and recovery join tests before enabling execution
Retain pilot/trust-stage prerequisites for execution; contract design can proceed without claiming those prerequisites implemented
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures/design only; no service activation, credentials, model calls or external effects.
validation: Review against existing policy/ledger/worker recovery and F-006 grading contracts
Run applicable documentation/work/backlog checks; no runtime confinement claim
escalation: Unsupported host enforcement or unclear trust boundary blocks execution; do not substitute a worktree or subprocess
New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): deterministic isolated runner admission and enforcement contract. Later steps F-049-T02–T10 planned 2026-11-11. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 3 hours agent; former 2-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 3 h → 1.75 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (1.75 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
